Grand Theft Auto VI becomes one of the biggest entertainment launches ever

Grand Theft Auto VI became one of the most successful entertainment launches of all time. The video game was described as painstakingly human. Its launch came on the same day Anthropic entered the public market.

Reported by TechCrunch.
